item.command: /bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- fixture-origin.md ---'; sed -n '1,260p' fixture-origin.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- AGENTS.md ---'; sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!evidence-local'"' | sort"
/bin/bash -c 'git rev-parse --show-toplevel; git rev-parse HEAD; git status --short --untracked-files=all; git ls-files'
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' package.json; sed -n '1,320p' capture-browser.mjs; sed -n '1,300p' build.mjs; sed -n '1,320p' server.mjs"
/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,360p' src/app.js; sed -n '1,280p' index.html; printf '\\n--- ignores ---\\n'; if [ -f .gitignore ]; then sed -n '1,200p' .gitignore; else printf '%s\\n' '(no .gitignore)'; fi"

/bin/bash -c "node --version; npm --version; ffmpeg -version | sed -n '1p'; ffprobe -version | sed -n '1p'; for p in /usr/bin/google-chrome /usr/bin/chromium /usr/bin/chromium-browser; do [ -x \""'$p" ] && printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$p"; done; if [ -n "$CHROME_PATH" ]; then printf '"'CHROME_PATH=%s\\n' \""'$CHROME_PATH"; fi; if [ -d node_modules ]; then printf '"'node_modules=present\\n'; else printf 'node_modules=absent\\n'; fi"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,360p' /tmp/dsh-pr115-behavior-clean.9zycuS/fixture/.agents/skills/dsh-spec-browser-gif-evidence/scripts/encode-browser-gif.mjs; printf '\\n--- capture report ---\\n'; sed -n '1,260p' evidence-local/capture-report.json; printf '\\n--- frame metadata ---\\n'; file evidence-local/00-initial.png evidence-local/01-saving.png evidence-local/02-saved.png"

/bin/bash -c 'mkdir -p evidence-local/qa && ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif -vf "fps=1,scale=360:-1:flags=lanczos,tile=4x2:padding=8:margin=8" -frames:v 1 evidence-local/qa/fixture-demo-contact-sheet.png && file evidence-local/qa/fixture-demo-contact-sheet.png && sha256sum evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif evidence-local/qa/fixture-demo-contact-sheet.png'

/bin/bash -c 'ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height,nb_frames,duration,r_frame_rate -show_entries format=format_name,duration,size -of json evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif; git check-ignore -v evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif evidence-local/00-initial.png evidence-local/capture-report.json; git status --short --untracked-files=all'

/bin/bash -c "git diff --quiet && printf 'tracked_diff=clean\\n'; test -f evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif && test -f evidence-local/capture-report.json && printf 'evidence=present\\n'; git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all | sed -n '1,120p'; git rev-parse HEAD"

/bin/bash -c 'leftovers=$(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'gif-evidence-chrome-*' -print); if [ -n \""'$leftovers" ]; then printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$leftovers"; else printf '"'temporary_browser_profiles=none\\n'; fi; ps -eo pid=,args= | rg 'capture-browser|gif-evidence-chrome|server\\.mjs|chrome-headless-shell' | rg -v 'rg ' || true"

/bin/bash -c "stat -c '%n | %s bytes' evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif evidence-local/00-initial.png evidence-local/01-saving.png evidence-local/02-saved.png evidence-local/capture-report.json; sha256sum evidence-local/fixture-demo.gif"
